content.text: This appears to have been broken throughout the 3.x line.
Fixed in 3.8.1-SNAPSHOT
if you can verify that would be great.
https://github.com/fcrepo3/fcrepo/commit/0ff095f6938f095711a454fe422963c90c7344c3
1. Works with simple test object. See attachment.
2. Getting NPE with the AtomZip I've created earlier:
https://github.com/qucosa/qucosa-vagrant/blob/master/puppet/modules/fedora/files/qucosa_1_atom.zip
. Something changed in the serialization?

Not that I'm aware of; I'll look into it.
I wasn't able to reproduce your problem- I downloaded that ZIP file and:
curl -X POST -u fedoraAdmin "
http://localhost:8080/fedora/objects/qucosa:1?format=info:fedora/fedora-system:ATOMZip-1.1
" --data-binary @qucosa_1_atom.zip -H "Content-Type:application/zip"

Ingested without error. Instead, I made a minor change to the 3.8.1-SNAPSHOT to prevent your particular NullPointer from happening, because it is obscuring another error that might make the problem clearer.
Works for me now.
Sorry, looks like the file was corrupted. I downloaded it again. Ingest works both via curl and via Admin Console.
so we may mark this issue and
https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1233
as fixed? It is the last open ticket for 3.8.1
I would say so.
https://github.com/fcrepo3/fcrepo/commit/0ff095f6938f095711a454fe422963c90c7344c3
The checksum is verified before the content is read from a Zip entry (controlGroup X) or the dsLocation is set (controlGroup M), resulting in a NullPointerException.
